conversation.message: For software implementation, breaking down the project into smaller, manageable phases can be very helpful. Clearly defining scope and requirements upfront also tends to smooth the process considerably.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: To clearly define requirements, workshops with stakeholders are invaluable for gathering input and documenting user stories or use cases. Iterative feedback loops also help refine these requirements throughout the planning stage.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: What are the differences between user stories and use cases?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: User stories are concise, informal descriptions of a feature from an end-user perspective, while use cases offer more detailed, step-by-step descriptions of how a user interacts with a system to achieve a goal. Both are valuable for capturing different levels of detail in requirements.
